stories.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.simple_summary: Companies are making AI assistants that work inside text messages. You can chat with them about travel, work, family, and general questions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you text a lot, you might soon be able to use these helpers without downloading a separate app — but you don't need to do anything yet.

stories.title: The Future of Wildfire Response: AI, Drones, and Robots
stories.simple_summary: AI and robots are being tested to help fight wildfires faster and smarter.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in a wildfire area, this could mean better protection eventually, though it will take time to roll out.

stories.title: ChatGPT-6 Astra plays World of Warcraft 'blind' and clears the orc starting zone in 40 minutes with no deaths — AI agent navigates by parsing raw server network packets and SQL files
stories.simple_summary: This is a story about AI software playing a video game without being shown the screen — it won by reading the computer's hidden data instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and AI experts — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: AI's race to transform the world before the money runs out
stories.simple_summary: Companies are spending huge amounts of money on AI development and racing to prove it's worth the cost before they run out of money.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to investors and tech company executives — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
stories.simple_summary: Meta is giving away free code so other companies can add its AI assistant (called Muse) to gadgets like TVs and toasters.
stories.why_it_matters: In the future, everyday appliances might talk to you with AI, but there's nothing for you to do right now.

stories.title: Trump expected to name intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
stories.simple_summary: The government is expected to appoint Jay Clayton to oversee AI policy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important for tracking government AI rules — nothing you need to do immediately.

stories.title: OpenAI investigating other potential AI hacking incidents after Hugging Face breach
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is checking if hackers broke into their systems, after similar hackers broke into another AI company's systems.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT, know that companies are taking security seriously and investigating — but there's no action you need to take unless you hear more details.

stories.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
stories.simple_summary: A businessman named Sean Parker is helping rebuild an AI company that makes music, and the music industry is backing him this time.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to the music industry and investors — not something you need to think about.

stories.title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
stories.simple_summary: Meta is letting people build their own devices with AI using free code — things like smart displays or TV add-ons that can help remind you of things.
stories.why_it_matters: If you like tinkering with gadgets, you could try making one, but most people will just wait for companies to sell finished products.

stories.title: The Powerful Yet Fragile Force Propping Up Stocks and the Economy
stories.simple_summary: A financial report about what's keeping the stock market and economy strong right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a financial news story for investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
stories.simple_summary: Apple is adding security locks to Macs to protect against AI programs that might try to snoop through all your files without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This is good news — Apple is protecting you from a real risk that AI agents could see your private data.

stories.title: Prediction: This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chip Stock Will Make a Big Move in October (Hint: It’s Not Micron)
stories.simple_summary: A stock advisor is predicting a particular AI chip company's stock will move a lot in October.
stories.why_it_matters: This is advice for stock investors only — nothing relevant to everyday life or small business.
